spec_gaps.description: X-008 (the list-cap decision) is open — 200 is only the recommended default. The condition therefore exercises the CAP THROUGH THE CONFIGURED CAP, not the 200 literal: the oracle configures a low cap (5) against a fixture with more members, so the boundary is exercised for real without pinning a number the design has not settled.
